title: Finite-order strict total positivity conjecture for the Cauchy kernel
statement:
Let $K_\alpha$ denote the Cauchy kernel considered in the paper, and let ${\rm STP}_n$ and ${\rm SR}_n$ denote strict total positivity and sign-regularity of order $n$, respectively. **Finite-order positivity conjecture.** For every $n\ge 2$, one has

$$
\alpha < 1/n \;\Rightarrow\; K_\alpha\,\in{\rm STP}_n.
$$

The preceding theorem establishes this implication under the stronger condition $\alpha\le 1/n\wedge 1/(n^2-n-6)_+$, and the conjecture asserts the expected optimal range. Its validity would complete the finite-order characterization suggested by the theorem.
references:
Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/1305.1173

Status: no resolution is reported in the source (as of May 2013).
source_name: Thomas Simon, “Total positivity of a Cauchy kernel”, arXiv:1305.1173 (2013).
